title: HBF-Sim: An Extensible HBF Simulator for Large-scale GPU Memory Systems
summary: High-bandwidth flash (HBF) is introduced to address the memory wall, which can co-package a dense NAND stack with the GPU, targeting the performance gap between near-accelerator bandwidth and flash density. HBF, however, is neither a large HBM nor a fast NVMe SSD. Its usable bandwidth depends on how GPU cache-line requests map onto NAND pages, how concurrency spreads across channel-affine die sets, and how media management interacts with the GPU memory pipeline. displayTitle: HBF-Sim：大规模 GPU 内存系统的高带宽闪存模拟器
narrative: 今日 arxiv cs.AR 上 HBF-Sim 论文针对业界新提出的 "High-Bandwidth Flash（HBF）"——一种把密集 NAND stack 与 GPU co-package 的内存扩展方案——给出可扩展模拟器。HBF 既不是大容量 HBM 也不是快 NVMe SSD，其可用带宽取决于 GPU 如何调度，模拟器就成为评估 HBF 在真实 LLM 推理 / 训练负载下表现的关键工具。对 NVIDIA / AMD 是中性偏利好——HBF 一旦成熟，GPU 可用 memory pool 会从 80GB 跃升到 TB 级，是 LLM 推理成本曲线的下一个拐点；对国内存储芯片（长江存储 / 长鑫存储 / 兆易创新）是结构性利好——HBF 把 NAND 推到 GPU 旁边，是 NAND 价值链的纵向升级机会。短期看是论文 + 开源工具，长期看 HBF 模拟生态成熟度会决定 HBF 何时进入大规模量产。
